rules.rationale: Source ESOL prior gives smiles_short +6.89; small solutes need little cavity work to solvate.
Source prior for smiles_mid is -6.61; extra nonpolar surface raises cavity-formation cost.
Ring role carried the highest transfer weight (0.76); acyclic solutes lack rigid hydrophobic ring surface.
Rotatable-bond role maps to branching (weight 0.76); low branching means less buried nonpolar volume.

skills.hypothesis: Transfers signed ESOL length priors and the high-weight ring and branch roles, assuming solubility and hydration share size-driven cavity mechanisms. Fails if hydration is governed by polar hydrogen bonding rather than solute size.

rules.rationale: Dense N/O centers form strong water hydrogen bonds, the dominant favorable term in hydration free energy.
Moderate heteroatom content still supplies polar solvation while covering 91 candidates for surrogate stability.
Unsubstituted hydrocarbons offer no hydrogen-bond partners and pay full hydrophobic cavity cost.
Extensive halogenation adds nonpolar, weakly hydrogen-bonding surface despite higher polarizability.

skills.hypothesis: Downweights the low-confidence ESOL length role (0.22) and asserts heteroatom polarity drives hydration. Fails if the score rewards compact nonpolar solutes or if polar bins are too sparse to inform the surrogate.

lesson: Source role confidences are low (0.16-0.41) and length is the weakest role, so a mechanistic polarity hypothesis with graded heteroatom coverage and fast semantic decay is safer than literal size transfer.
revision_summary: Corrected all conditions to the required field-to-value object form. Kept the source-grounded transfer with signed length priors and the highest-weight ring and branch roles. Strengthened the counter-hypothesis by replacing the near-constant short-length reversal with a hetero_mid coverage rule and a mechanistic hydrocarbon interaction (hetero_none plus halogen_none), improving surrogate support beyond the sparse hetero_high bin. Both skills decay semantic mass toward the target-only anchor; the polarity skill is frozen for deployment.
